title: Ultraviolette F99 Factory Racing Edition (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Ultraviolette Automotive Ultraviolette F99 Factory Racing Edition (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 14L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
